result.summary: Implemented ISS-0169 tranche 1 (LUA-05, LUA-06, LUA-07) per the validated design. Closed the capability enforcement hole: the ExecutionContext now reaches every lua_CFunction through LUA_REGISTRYINDEX light userdata, and all 6 gated platform.* functions check the CapabilitySet at call time and fail closed. Opened luaopen_base then pruned dangerous globals (SBX-1). Unified product and test state behind a single createSandboxedState (SBX-2). Manifest hash now binds the script source digest with sorted, 0x00-separated capabilities; added parseManifest and constant-time verifyManifestHash; fixed the deinit leak. Added executeScriptWithManifest, which rejects a hash mismatch before any Lua state is created. Fixed the two files that did not compile (instruction_limiter discarded a c_int; memory_limiter used std.Thread.Mutex, removed in Zig 0.16) — compile only, no limiter is installed (tranche 2). EMPIRICAL PROOF against real vendored LuaJIT: with an EMPTY CapabilitySet all 6 gated functions are denied with a structured message naming the function, the required capability and the granted set; with the capability granted the same calls succeed; a variable:read grant does not open write_variable; call_service is gated per service id. Gate verified LOAD-BEARING by deliberate mutation: neutering requireCapability turns exactly the 4 capability tests red, then restoring it returns 53/53 green.

validation.zig build test: exit 0 (all targets green; src/lua target 53/53 pass)
validation.lint_handoffs.py: no findings against WF03-ISS-0169-20260806 (2043 pre-existing historical findings unrelated to this run)
validation.capability_gate_mutation_test: gate disabled -> 4 capability tests FAIL; gate restored -> 53/53 PASS

issues.description: NEW incidental defect, filed and forwarded (NOT fixed on this branch): src/oidc/jwks.zig does not compile under Zig 0.16 (stale std.Thread.Mutex at :322 plus three std.ArrayList(T).init/.deinit() call sites), yet zig build is green because src/main.zig only re-exports it and nothing calls into it — the same ISS-0172/GH #500 blind spot in the OIDC token-cache and JTI replay-denylist path. Verified empirically with a throwaway probe root. Does not block ISS-0169: nothing in src/lua/ imports it. Registered as docs/issues/ISS-0173.json, filed as https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/501, queued via tools/queue_add.py.

Scope note, per design §9 and §6.5: this tranche gates the six functions but does NOT implement their bodies (read/write_variable stage nothing, log writes nothing, emit_event appends nothing, get_instance_state returns an empty table, call_service keeps its simulation path) — LUA-11/12/13 and tranche 4. Manifest limits are validated and carried but NO limiter is installed — LUA-08/09/10, tranche 2. Persisting manifest_hash into the audit record is the engine's job (design §11.2).
